intro: Dancing for Marzipan is a festive Hallow's End quest offered by Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff. To gather a sweet treat for a sick orphan, adventurers must put aside their battle-hardened dignity and perform a joyful dance for the innkeeper. It highlights the playful, community-focused spirit of the holiday even high upon the windswept mesas of Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Even though you're trick-or-treating for a sick child, you still need to perform a trick for the treat! We can't very well change the tradition, now can we...
I believe the cost of a piece of marzipan nowadays is to bust out and DANCE! That's right, let me see your moves! Dance for me, and I'll give you some tasty marzipan!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You know how to dance, don't you? Try by putting your right foot in... Then your right foot out... Your right foot in... Shake it all about...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're quite the dancing machine, friend!
Here's your treat for being such a good sport. Happy Hallow's End, and give my best to your sick little friend! I hope they get better soon.
